pages.text: Each dungeon vault is a small room whose six faces are made of $(item)Warded Masonry$(): bricks marked with a faint rune, unbreakable and explosion-proof. No way to dig around it! When the boss dies, the seals of the door vanish and the masonry turns back into ordinary bricks.$(br2)Dungeons also hide $(l)Mimics$() among their chests.
pages.title: Coffres-forts
